# Geeta Creations

> Geeta Creations is a Jaipur studio where artist Geeta Chauhan paints chiffon, kota doria and organza sarees, suits and dupattas entirely by hand. Every piece is one of a kind, in soft pastel florals (roses, lilies, lotus, hydrangea, lilac). Custom commissions are welcome. Website: https://chandrika-singh.github.io/GeetaCreations/

## Contact and ordering
- WhatsApp / phone: +91 94134 75894
- Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Studio viewings by appointment. Ships across India.
- How to order: message on WhatsApp with the piece name or code (e.g. GC-01), or describe colours, flowers and occasion for a custom piece. Geeta sends a sketch for approval before painting.
- Languages: English and Hindi.

## Prices
- Hand-painted sarees: about ₹7,500 to ₹11,500
- Unstitched hand-painted suits: from ₹7,000
- Some pieces are priced on request.

## About Geeta Chauhan (founder, artist, designer)
Geeta Creations is a founder-led brand: Geeta Chauhan designs every saree, paints every piece by hand, and runs the business herself from her atelier in Jaipur, including collections, custom commissions, client appointments and shipping. She has been painting sarees and sharing her work since at least 2013. Each piece is stretched on a wooden frame and painted in layers, light to deep, with fabric colours that are then set.

## Care
Dry clean only. Store folded in muslin and refold every few months. Apply perfume before draping. Iron on the reverse at a low setting.
